name: Santana's
notes: Own ordering platform (Smart Online Order / Clover, first-party, linked from santanasmexfood.com/locations/ for this exact address). Rendered ordering UI truncates categories; read directly from the Clover REST API (/wp-json/moo-clover/v1/categories and /items) to get the whole menu, including items behind 'Show More'. All 16 categories captured except 'Otros' (disposable utensils - fork/straw/spoon/knife at $0.26 each, not food) which was omitted as not a dish. Chips/Fries (C/F) items are priced via a required size modifier (Half/Full) rather than a base price - both size prices are given per item. Refreshments: most named sodas (Coca Cola, Sprite, Horchata, Orange, Minute Maid Lemonade, Diet Coke, Limonada, Jamaica, Dr. Pepper, HiC Fruitpunch) are fountain drinks priced via a Med/Lg size modifier (confirmed $2.86/$3.33 on Coca Cola) rather than a flat price - noted as one entry. Daily Specials 'FRIDAY' had no price anywhere on the platform and was omitted. Prices did not show a markup pattern (varied cent endings, not a clean multiplier), consistent with first-party checkout pricing. COMPLETE capture of the food and drink menu.

name: Manhattan Cocktail Lounge
notes: Dive bar / cocktail lounge, drink-led venue, no food. Own site (manhattanbar91910.com, cert expired but genuine - reached with curl -k) hosts a draft-beer chalkboard photo and an Excel-exported bottle list, but the draft list page explicitly states 'Updated 3/13/16' - about 10 years old - and the site itself says the draft selection is 'constantly changing', so the specific beers and prices are not representative of today. This is well past the point FINDINGS calls archaeology rather than dated. No newer priced source was found: Yelp's Drink photo tab (22 photos) has glassware/cocktail shots but no visible price board or menu photo, no Toast/Clover/other ordering platform found, and delivery platforms don't list this bar. Recorded as not-found rather than using the decade-old board.

name: Victoria's Mexican Grill
notes: Own domain (victoriasmexican.com) no longer resolves (DNS failure, likely lapsed). Site links to victoriamex.top exist in search results but were not used - .top TLD matches the brand-twin/fabricated-listing pattern and was avoided. Source used is MenuStar (themenustar.com), a hosted menu microsite in the same tier-2 family as res-menu.net/kwickmenu.com. Category tabs are an accordion that only renders items once clicked and scrolled into view - all 12 categories (Popular Items, Combination Plates, Enchiladas, Burritos, Side Orders, Breakfast Burritos, Breakfast Plates, Tortas, Tostadas, Tacos, Drinks, Especiales) were opened and captured in full. Prices are internally consistent (e.g. individual tacos ~$2.60-3.10 vs. combo-plate two-taco prices ~$7.75-8.99 once rice/beans are added), which is a mild sign against staleness, but there is no independent cross-check, so confidence is capped at medium. COMPLETE capture of all 12 categories.
